stem: A pharmacist prepares for biennial renewal. Select all generally applicable Massachusetts CE rules.

choices.text: Complete at least 20 contact hours in each calendar year of the cycle.
Carry unused hours freely into the next year.
Include at least two contact hours of pharmacy law in each calendar year.
Complete all 40 hours in the final month of the cycle.
Home study has no annual limit.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. A renewing pharmacist generally completes 20 contact hours in each calendar year of the two-year cycle, including at least two hours of pharmacy law each year, with limits on home study and daily credit.

choice_analysis.A: The proposition 'Complete at least 20 contact hours in each calendar year of the cycle.' is supported by Massachusetts pharmacist continuing education: A renewing pharmacist generally completes 20 contact hours in each calendar year of the two-year cycle, including at least two hours of pharmacy law each year, with limits on home study and daily credit.
choice_analysis.B: This statement imports Schedule II prescriptions may not be refilled without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
choice_analysis.C: The proposition 'Include at least two contact hours of pharmacy law in each calendar year.' is supported by Massachusetts pharmacist continuing education: A renewing pharmacist generally completes 20 contact hours in each calendar year of the two-year cycle, including at least two hours of pharmacy law each year, with limits on home study and daily credit.
choice_analysis.D: This statement imports Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
choice_analysis.E: This statement imports Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.

related_facts: A renewing pharmacist generally completes 20 contact hours in each calendar year of the two-year cycle, including at least two hours of pharmacy law each year, with limits on home study and daily credit.
explanation.mpje_trap: Selecting a familiar statement without checking whether its schedule, setting, deadline, and exception match the facts.

Apply the exception and documentation conditions before selecting the final pharmacy action
